title: MedAgent-R1: Faithfulness-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Medical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.30676v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When medical AI systems hallucinate clinical reasoning, the consequences extend beyond incorrect answers: fabricated justifications that superficially reference retrieved evidence can mislead clinicians into unsafe treatment decisions. Medical reasoning agents must therefore produce not only correct answers but also faithful justifications that clinicians can verify against cited evidence. We identify a systematic failure mode in RL-trained retrieval agents: outcome-only rewards improve accuracy while degrading faithfulness, a phenomenon we term confident hallucination. The agent learns to answer from parametric memory and backfill plausible but unsupported justifications; citation fabrication rates rise from 16.5% to 31.8% even as accuracy improves by 5 points over the supervised baseline. We address this with a faithfulness-gated reward design: accuracy credit is conditioned on evidence grounding via a hard gate, complemented by retrie

translated_title: MedAgent-R1：面向证据支撑医学推理的忠实性感知强化学习
translated_abstract: 当医疗AI系统在临床推理中产生幻觉时，其后果不仅限于给出错误答案：那些表面上引用了检索证据的捏造性论证可能会误导临床医生做出不安全的治疗决策。因此，医学推理智能体不仅必须给出正确的答案，还必须提供临床医生能够对照所引证据进行验证的忠实论证。我们在强化学习训练的检索智能体中发现了一种系统性的失败模式：仅基于结果的奖励在提高准确率的同时会降低忠实性，我们将这一现象称为“自信幻觉”。智能体学会从参数记忆中直接作答，并回填看似合理但缺乏证据支持的论证；引用捏造率从16.5%上升到31.8%，而准确率仅比监督基线提高了5个百分点。我们通过一种忠实性门控的奖励设计来解决这一问题：准确率奖励通过硬性门控以证据支撑为前提条件，并辅以检索...
tldr: 该论文提出MedAgent-R1，通过忠实性门控奖励的强化学习方法，解决了医学推理智能体中“自信幻觉”问题（即仅优化结果奖励虽提升准确率却使引用捏造率从16.5%升至31.8%），确保AI医学论证可被临床医生对照证据验证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MedAgent-R1, a faithfulness-gated reinforcement learning framework that addresses "confident hallucination" in medical reasoning agents—where outcome-only rewards improve accuracy but inflate citation fabrication rates from 16.5% to 31.8%—by conditioning accuracy rewards on evidence grounding.
